ns2:section.sectionText: This introductory course will focus on identifying foundational concepts necessary to strengthen individual and group leadership skills and provide experiences to assist in applying these skills while navigating college life. Topics include: Identifying and utilizing personal values, defining "leadership", tools to seek out & create leadership opportunities, and how to apply leadership skills to college career for academic success.
ns2:section.sectionNotes: Restricted to Agric Leadership & Sci Educ major(s).
